author: nothinbeat
quote: I played this game all the way through floor 99. The performance of it was impressive on such a small device. There was not a single frame drop in the 90 hours i have played it. I also love that there's a feature to help others on their raids

author: nothinbeat
quote: I was born in 1998 when the original came out. This is my first time to play the game and I am super amazed how the mechanics work. The previous 3D Zelda games I played were BOTW, TOTK, and Skyward Sword. This remake has become my second favorite 3D Zelda after BOTW. Now I understand why it is so highly acclaimed
